column1: Carrier Deployment Seeds — IMO-Level Service Evidence

Interpretation rule: a carrier schedule is evidence that the vessel is deployed/marketed on that carrier's service. It is NOT, by itself, evidence that the carrier is the registered owner, beneficial owner, technical manager, ISM manager or actual ship operator.
